commitments.description: Send the General Counsel the written follow-up review with the evidence table.
Share the correction-category analysis with the two supervising partners.
Propose three dates for the sponsor meeting to the managing partner's office.

escalations.topic: No active sponsor, 47 days before the renewal date when raised.
escalations.decisionNeeded: Decide whether the regional lead joins the sponsor meeting and who owns the renewal conversation.

escalations.topic: Customer requests 40 further seats for a workflow whose value is not demonstrated; the lead specialist has no spare hours.
escalations.decisionNeeded: Agree the position for the commercial conversation and decide whether support hours move to this account.

escalations.topic: Connector pilot had no agreed priority against two other integration requests.
escalations.decisionNeeded: Set the order of the three integration requests.

coachingActions.observation: The refresher training was proposed on the customer's own explanation of the problem, without testing it against the correction data.
coachingActions.action: Before the next proposal, write down the hypothesis and the observation that would disprove it; review both in the weekly one-to-one.

coachingActions.observation: First independently delivered session. The follow-up measure was set after delivery and has not been agreed with the customer.
coachingActions.action: Agree the measure for the sign-off session with the Employment lead, then shadow the follow-up review on 28 August.

coachingActions.observation: The diagnosis used shadowed reviews and a time sample before any action was proposed, and named the confounders in the evaluation.
coachingActions.action: Present the diagnosis method at the team session so it becomes the shared template for intervention proposals.
